generalAbilities.name: Lifesense 30 feet
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

Lifesense allows a monster to sense the vital essence of living and undead creatures within the listed range. The sense can distinguish between the vitality energy animating living creatures and the void energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.

defensiveAbilities.name: Twilight Spirit
defensiveAbilities.description: The faith of its descendants protects the iruxi ossature. It takes no damage from vitality or void energy, and it can be healed by either vitality or void energy.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fossil Fury
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per hour

Effects The iruxi ossature beckons with glowing hands, commanding the earth to trip up opponents and marshaling the bone walls of its protectorate to lash out at intruders. The floor in a 30ft Cone in front of the ossature becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. Any square of a wall built by iruxis that's in the cone lashes out, with fossilized claws damaging any enemy within 5 feet of the wall. This deals 6d6 Piercing Damage damage with a Basic DC 22 Reflex Saving Throw. A creature attempts the save only once, even if adjacent to more than one affected square of the wall. Fossil Fury has no effect on the ossature's allies and never damages iruxi eggs.

offensiveAbilities.name: Terrain Advantage
offensiveAbilities.description: Non-lizardfolk creatures in difficult terrain and non-lizardfolk creatures that are in water and lack a swim Speed are Off-Guard to the iruxi ossature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Totems of the Past
offensiveAbilities.description:
The iruxi ossature visits visions made of starlight, resembling totemic paintings or constellation diagrams, upon creatures in a 30ft Emanation. Any lizardfolk allies in the area are inspired, gaining a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, and each enemy in the area must succeed at a DC 21 Will Saving Throw save or be Dazzled. Both effects last for 1 minute or until the ossature is destroyed, whichever comes first.

Effect: Totems of the Past
